title: TACTIC: Temporal and Context-Aware LLM Tactical Planning for Roadside LiDAR Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2609.39969v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical LiDAR attacks are often evaluated using fixed primitives and manually selected parameters, despite their strong dependence on surrounding traffic. We present TACTIC, a scene-aware framework that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to coordinate state-adaptive roadside LiDAR attacks. Under a gray-box threat model, TACTIC relies only on an attacker-operated roadside perception stack, without accessing the victim LiDAR's native point clouds or internal processing. Local perception provides metric vehicle states, while the MLLM combines these measurements with roadside imagery to infer relational traffic context and construct a semantic scene graph. Based on this representation, TACTIC selects and configures two complementary primitives: \emph{push-away}, which shifts the perceived range of a lead vehicle, and \emph{phantom-obstacle braking}, which triggers emergency braking through obstacle injection. translated_title: TACTIC：面向路侧激光雷达攻击的时序与上下文感知大语言模型战术规划
translated_abstract: 物理激光雷达攻击通常使用固定的攻击原语和人工选择的参数进行评估，尽管这类攻击对周围交通环境有很强的依赖性。我们提出了TACTIC，这是一个场景感知框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来协调状态自适应的路侧激光雷达攻击。在灰盒威胁模型下，TACTIC仅依赖于攻击者自行搭建的路侧感知系统，无需访问受害激光雷达的原生点云或其内部处理过程。本地感知提供车辆的度量状态信息，多模态大语言模型则将这些测量数据与路侧图像相结合，推断关联的交通上下文并构建语义场景图。基于这一表示，TACTIC选择并配置两种互补的攻击原语：推离（push-away），即改变前车的感知距离；以及幽灵障碍物制动（phantom-obstacle braking），即通过注入虚拟障碍物触发紧急制动。实测交通场景的结果表明，相比固定的攻击策略，TACTIC能够……
tldr: 该论文提出TACTIC框架，利用多模态大语言模型融合路侧感知数据构建语义场景图，在灰盒威胁模型下自适应地选择并配置“推离”和“幽灵障碍物制动”两种攻击原语，实现了场景感知、状态自适应的路侧激光雷达攻击。
en_tdlr: TACTIC is a scene-aware framework that uses a multimodal large language model to build semantic scene graphs from attacker-side roadside perception, adaptively selecting and configuring push-away and phantom-obstacle braking primitives for state-adaptive roadside LiDAR attacks under a gray-box threat model.
